name: Bulkbite App Shell
job: Keep Dashboard, Receipts, and Production immediately visible inside an Actual category surface, reveal theoretical workflows inline inside a second labelled category surface, and expose frequent supporting destinations in the collapsible sidebar without removing the wider system.

iconProvider.rule: Use familiar line icons beside persistent labels. Collapsed destinations retain accessible names and tooltips.

incomingHandoff: A signed-in staff member enters BulkBite operations and needs the current stock state or a specific stock task.
outgoingHandoff: The selected workflow receives the shared snapshot, stock data, and one clear operational focus.
responsiveBehaviour: Use a collapsible utility sidebar for frequent supporting destinations, plus one muted top area containing labelled Actual and Theoretical category surfaces. The Theoretical surface expands inline to reveal its destinations. On narrow screens stack the category surfaces, allow their controls to wrap, recompose the sidebar into compact horizontal groups, and keep every destination and account action reachable.

layoutContract.containment: A collapsible soft-charcoal sidebar owns identity, icon-labelled daily tools, core management links, the full setup handoff, and one compact avatar-name-action account row. A unified muted BulkBite-orange top area owns page identity and a fixed-footprint Refresh action. Below it, labels sit outside and above two bounded cards: Actual holds the three daily workflows, while Theoretical expands inline to hold the wider planning system.

surfaceContract.contentSeparation: Content padding does not define primitive bounds.
surfaceContract.rule: No primitive surface is mounted until its semantic owner and edge behavior are chosen.

motionContract.justification: A short horizontal layout transition preserves object continuity while the Theoretical category expands, without delaying route selection.
motionContract.reducedMotion: Render the final expanded or collapsed state immediately without transforms.
